incidents-bot: PAGER DUTY -> HIGH: Hartwell (enterprise-vpc) model errors >10% over 5m on dedicated-pool-03. PagerID: PD12345
robert (oncall): acked, paging in. pulling logs, assigning to SRE
jules (cs): Hartwell reported 502s in checkout webhooks; they say ~15% of requests getting fail responses. Customer impact: degraded checkout confirmations. CS has them on standby.
maya (sre): looking at pods in dedicated-pool-03, seeing high KV cache misses and model decode timeouts. top offending model: hartwell-prod-v2 (quantized). queue depth spiking.
alex (eng): observed increased tail latency from model variant v2q-8bit across longer context. Suspect quantization path regression after last roll.
robert (oncall): prioritizing mitigation: 1) immediate pin to safevariant hartwell-prod-v2-safe (v1.9-quant-stable) for Hartwell tenant only 2) route traffic to regional fallback pool (dedicated-pool-11 eu-west) for new requests 3) keep diagnostic traces
jules (cs): can we do tenant-scoped pinning without downtime? Hartwell needs minimal disruption.
maya (sre): yes, we can apply tenant pin in routing policy. will do canary to 5% first. command:
```bash
rwctl route update --tenant hartwell --pin-model hartwell-prod-v2-safe --canary 5
```
alex (eng): also enabling safe KV cache bypass for pinned traffic:
```json
{"tenant":"hartwell","kv_cache":false,"max_seq":1024}
```
robert (oncall): executing pin now.
maya (sre): roll applied. canary 5% -> 0 errors in canary sample (200 reqs). ramping to 30%.
jules (cs): Hartwell confirms canary traffic shows successful checkouts. :thumbsup:
robert (oncall): ramping to 100% for tenant. updating incident status to mitigated->customer impact reduced. creating follow-up doc.
maya (sre): scheduling postmortem and recommending rollback of last quantization patch or tighter compatibility tests. Setting alert for error rate >2% for next 24h.
lynn (customer-sre): noted. I'll coordinate with Hartwell's SRE for timeline and possible hotfix rollout window.
